info.name: RetryGuard
info.description:
RetryGuard - Smart API Retry & Failure Tracker.

Run the whole collection top to bottom with the Collection Runner. Every scenario creates its own data, so the run does not depend on what is already in the database. Requires the app on {{baseUrl}} with retryguard.retry.max-delay-ms=2000.
